purpose: Choose a bounded time from a tokenized ten4seven listbox interaction.
accessibility: Expose a labelled input with aria-expanded, aria-controls, and listbox semantics.
Support keyboard opening, Escape dismissal, visible focus, and selected option state.
responsive: Positions the listbox in viewport space and keeps it inside narrow viewports.
Retains shared touch-target minimums and field geometry.
motion: Uses shared popup duration and easing.

api.name: value
api.description: Current selected time in HH:mm form.

api.name: onValueChange
api.description: Callback fired with the next selected time or undefined when cleared.

api.name: minuteStep
api.description: Spacing in minutes between available options.

api.name: min
api.description: Earliest available time in HH:mm form.

api.name: max
api.description: Latest available time in HH:mm form.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.
